entityDescription:
Polyteknik AS is a PVD equipment manufacturer with an innovative approach to solutions and service within the thin film industry.
With more than twenty years of experience in the business, a global reference list, and an excellent technological platform, Polyteknik AS has aspired as an appreciated and significant partner in the thin film industry.

PVD Systems
The portfolio of platform systems ranges from small scale R&D to high volume, or large area, deposition systems. In addition, Polyteknik AS covers several deposition processes, which includes sputtering, evaporation, and a variation of these. At Polyteknik AS, you will experience a high level of service and skill from our dedicated team. We are highly interested in strong cooperation to reach the best possible solution.

We offer both standard systems and joint customer developed systems for specific purposes.

Our reliable PVD systems features:
•Modular standard systems
•Modular process packages
•Modular investment platforms

Coating Service
Polyteknik AS has various industrial coating equipment installed for daily subcontract coating (Coating Service). The Coating Service division has more than 10 different variations of in-house PVD systems. This enables us to present proof of the concepts of wafer, 3D objects or even roll-to-roll, which is essential for non-standard coatings. In addition, the daily production within Polyteknik has the focus on delivering electrode and EMI coatings in volume production.

DroneDesign SRLs is an innovative start-up founded in 2013 by with the main objective to develop detection solutions through autonomous aerial vehicles (UAVs) for professional purposes, both scientific and industrial.

As part of the project Agricopter, DroneDesign has developed electro-optical systems for detecting visible and infrared data, a software for flight planning of UAV on observation areas, carried out experiments in the field of aerial photogrammetry and acquired skills in data processing for remote sensing.
DroneDesign have professional equipment, including the flight deck and a series of cameras / sensors, which allow you to make low-altitude aerial surveys and high resolution in different spectral bands to serve different applications such as thermal imaging, 3D reconstruction, calculating vegetation indices.

entityDescription:
G-HiTech is pioneering the Global Energy Supply System (G-ESS), representing an innovative approach to energy distribution. Unlike traditional, centralized grids, our mesh-grid is fully decentralized, connecting distributed production nodes - each equipped with solar panels, batteries, and standalone inverters - to create modular energy communities. This modular design significantly advances energy democratization, particularly beneficial for emerging economies due to its modularity and energy-sharing capabilities.

To operationalize the G-ESS grid, G-HiTech is developing "SOLARSTEG," a software solution designed to facilitate maintenance and enable comprehensive energy management by tracking energy production & consumption along with payment follow-up. SOLARSTEG integrates advanced satellite communication (SatCom) and global navigation satellite system (GNSS) technologies to further promote energy democratization, especially in remote areas and emerging economies.
G-HiTech's mission is to empower communities with innovative, sustainable, and economically viable energy solutions. We focus on overcoming the challenges of energy access and reliability, transforming lives, and promoting socio-economic growth in the most underserved regions.

entityDescription:
Satways Ltd. is a privately held organization founded in May 2006, based in Athens, Greece with annexes in Patras and Larissa and presence in Germany (Astrial GmbH). The company’s main activity is the development of integrated Geospatial Command and Control solutions for Security, Public Safety and Defense. Satways product line includes integrated solutions for the following vertical markets: 
● Incident and Dispatch Systems for First Responders 
● Border Surveillance and Coordination
● Critical Infrastructure Protection
● Civil Protection Solutions for Natural Hazards Prevention, Preparedness, Early Warning, Response & Recovery
● Smart Cities Coordination – Digital Twins
● Defense 
Satways’ flagship product is ENGAGE C3I software platform with a unique modular architecture that permits easy customization to meet exact user requirements, easily increase capabilities of deployed solutions by adding additional modules and everything is available through a single unified end-user interface. It can be installed in fixed and deployable command centers and can also be accessed in the field via mobile data terminals. Their common goal is to make efficient use of available resources, to provide effective decision support, to simplify operations, to provide a Common Operational Picture (COP), Situation Awareness and collaboration tools across organizations, to collect and disseminate data in the field and to coordinate response units and system users.
In addition, Satways is developing seismic and acoustic sensor based real time acquisition and analysis systems for various applications in the areas of geophysics, seismology and earthquake engineering, as well as in border security and defense. Innovation was always Satways competitive advantage. entityDescription: ​Matt worked as an Engineer with the European Space Agency. He graduated from project PoSSUM Scientist-Astronaut program where his main focus was on pressurized suit operations, hypoxia, human performance in micro-g and high-g environment. He also graduated with Computer Science degree and studied Aerospace and Astronautics at Polish Air Force Academy. He is a bioastronautics researcher, private pilot, aerospace and software engineer, rescue diver and military combat medic (TCCC, ACLS). He helped ESA on Moon and Mars research with extraterrestrial habitats and Extravehicular Activities operations, 3D bioprinting, photosynthetic bioink, hydroponic and aquaponic plant cultivation, polarized light influence on time perception and human time architecture. Together with Lunares.space team he built a habitat in Poland. He was trusted to participate in three innovative analog missions. Matt received Copernicus Medal for creating foundations for Polish Human Spaceflight and building first Moon/Mars habitat in Europe. Currently he is writing HabitatOS an operating system for the extraterrestrial habitats. He also led a project management transformation for Polish Ministry of Interior's Center of Information Technology and helped more than hundred organizations with project management and software engineering as consultant and trainer.

entityDescription:
Algorithmica Srl (ALG) is an Italian research-oriented SME based in Rome, Italy. ALG is focused on robotics, cloud solutions, and entertainment applications with a particular interest on 3D reconstruction of real environments and virtual reality applications: ALG envisions autonomous robots as mobile sensors and the cloud as the enabling technology for building models out of the huge amount of data that robots collect. Starting from 2014, ALG’s investment in research and development has significantly grown: according to balance sheets, during the period 2014-2016, R&D investment has exceeded 60% of the overall costs and, in 2017, ALG has incremented it up to 80%. Leveraging on this effort it could become an “innovative SME” (Decree-Law 3/2015, known as “Investment Compact”, converted into Law 33/2015), thus enjoining the benefits the Italian Government proposed to support research and development activities of the high innovative Italian SMEs.
ALG past experiences include the participation to two FP7 EU projects: Cloud-TM, “A Novel Programming Language for the Cloud”(http://www.cloudtm.eu/), and ROVINA, “Robots for Exploration, Digital Preservation and Visualization of Archeological Sites” (http://www.rovina-project.eu/). ALG is currently involved in the HORIZON 2020 EU project INTCATCH, aiming at applying innovative approaches to the water monitoring (http://intcatch.eu/).

The core competencies are in the fields of additive manufacturing, metal cutting and sheet metal working.
In the field of additive manufacturing Aircraft Philipp Salzburg GmbH is providing the complete process chain no matter which batch size.

entityDescription:
The Federal Railway Authority (Eisenbahn-Bundesamt - EBA) is the German supervisory, licensing and safety authority for railways and railway undertakings.
EBA is an independent German higher federal authority and is part of the Federal Transport Administration. It is subject to supervisory and legal control by the Federal Ministry of Transport and Digital Infrastructure.
Over 2/3 of all railway undertakings in Germany are subject to supervision by the Federal Railway Authority.
The numerous functions of the Federal Railway Authority include plan approval for facilities of the federal railways, the authorization of rolling stock and railway infrastructure, and the granting of funds that the Federal Government has made available in the rail transport sector. 
In 2015 EBA has become a Federal Scientific Institution.
In addition, the Federal Railway Authority enforces passengers’ rights.
